observations: The governed first-tranche order is Q5 -> Q6 -> Q1.
Q9 may issue RUNTIME_AUTHORIZED only after Q1-Q8 are PASS while publicationState is QUALIFIED.
Only after Q9 may QUALIFIED -> PUBLISHED occur.
Q1 is defined as effective public/runtime surface reachability and fail-closed behavior for non-publishable states.
The current Q1 implementation requires publicationState=PUBLISHED and RUNTIME_AUTHORIZED to PASS, which creates a cycle because those conditions require Q9, while Q9 requires Q1 PASS first.
consequence: Q1 publication-state semantics cannot be declared IMPLEMENTED_TESTED and PR #50 cannot become review-ready until the contract distinguishes pre-Q9 reachability qualification from post-Q9 publication activation without weakening the rule that Q1 is real reachability evidence.
forbiddenShortcuts: Do not move Q9 before Q1.
Do not treat merge/deploy/cache as runtime authorization.
Do not reinterpret Q1 as Q6 editorial admission.
Do not expose a student runtime before Q9.
Do not mark the compliance matrix green by status editing alone.
